## Layer 3, the email (builder 5; T-455, T-457, T-458, S-129)

- T-455: the pending change is the sign-in service's (stand-in: memory beside its codes;
  Supabase: its own pending address, our store the code's attempts); 0031 widens the store's
  codes, adds the owner-run functions that move accounts.email (T-458). Accounts made before
  have no pending change; nothing reads one that is not there.
- Interface: `startEmailChange`, `confirmEmailChange` (both adapters; Supabase: generate_link
  `email_change_new`, verify `email_change`, needs "secure email change" off, unverified live).
- Commands `server/sign-in/start-own-email-change.ts`, `confirm-own-email-change.ts` (T-457),
  action `email-actions.ts` (refresh), form `features/sign-in/change-email-form.tsx`; port
  `ownEmail` (database: 0031's functions; stand-in: always free). Notices `mail.emailChange*`.
- Passed: both adapters' units, the commands, 0031 (pglite), app-role, isolation, test:web,
  check, typecheck, change-email-test (fails with the stand-in keeping other sessions),
  change-password-test, your-name-test. Not run: harmful-text (new `/account` pin newEmail).
